scope: A method-transfer control using known 1BRS interface information. Neither template nor restraint route is an independent blind docking benchmark. Rigid free-state side chains cannot reproduce every template contact; seven CA distance restraints guide patch placement, and all seven original closest-heavy-atom contacts remain separate diagnostics, not achieved interactions.

anchor.label: Barnase
anchor.selection_note: Bacillus amyloliquefaciens wildtype free barnase, source chain A modeled residues 3-110. Retain every modeled polymer heavy atom after occupancy/altloc filtering; omit nonpolymers and do not fill missing residues.

moving.label: Barstar C82A
moving.selection_note: B. amyloliquefaciens free barstar C82A, source chain A residues 1-89. Keep Cys40 despite Ala40 in template. Retain every modeled polymer heavy atom after occupancy/altloc filtering; omit nonpolymers.

template.selection_note: Known barnase-barstar complex, author chains A/D. Barstar has C40A/C82A; missing residues 64-65 are not supplied to the monomer. Template is an orientation reference only.
